description: Use after dora_gap_assessment when the user wants a plan to close their DORA gaps. Turns the same answers into every gap with a recommended action, a priority, the DORA article and a 30/60/90-day roadmap (ICT risk management and incident management first). Requires ClevSec Pro.

answers.description: Question id to answer, e.g. {"p1_1": "yes", "p2_3": "partial"}. Unanswered questions count as gaps.

name: dora_remediation_plan
title: DORA remediation plan (ClevSec Pro)
